title: ALMA observations of dual quasars: evidence of rich and diverse molecular gas environments
question: Are the host galaxies of five closely-separated dual quasars (z=0.4-0.8) more molecular-gas depleted than single quasars and inactive star-forming galaxies, and how is the CO gas distributed and moving in each pair?

recipe.method: Split calibrated MS into emission-line and continuum windows; estimate line FWHM from a spectral profile; stack remaining spectrum to measure continuum
key_parameters: FWHM estimated with spectral profile tool in casaviewer
Continuum from spectra excluding +/-5xFWHM of the line, found negligible

recipe.method: Split a window of width 2xFWHM centred on the line and run tclean in mfs mode with Multiscale deconvolver and natural weighting; make two M0 versions (one centred on each source) in double detections
key_parameters: Briggs robust = 2 (natural), chosen to maximize sensitivity
mfs for the line follows Akins et al. 2022; map in Jy/beam

recipe.goal: Measure line flux, position and size on the M0 map
recipe.method: Pre-estimate center, size and peak with casaviewer 2D fit, then fit with imfit to get the integrated line flux in Jy; physical sizes from imfit; non-detections assigned 3 sigma_bkg upper limits in one beam, assumed unresolved
key_parameters: Upper limit = 3 sigma_bkg in one beam; sigma_bkg is the std of the residual map

recipe.goal: Make cubes, moment maps and 1D spectra; fit line profiles
recipe.method: tclean cube with 10 km/s channels; M1/M2 via immoments over about 2xFWHM keeping pixels >~3 sigma; spectra from elliptical aperture, noise spectrum as median of four offset apertures; fit single or double-peaked Gaussian and keep the better; derive W50 and S/N
key_parameters: Noise apertures offset 40-50 pixels up, down, left, right of the source
S/N = model peak over noise std within +/-2xW50

recipe.goal: Derive CO luminosity and molecular gas mass
recipe.method: L'CO(2-1) from integrated flux with the Solomon et al. formula using Delta v = 2xFWHM; convert to CO(1-0) with R21 and to H2 mass with alpha_CO
key_parameters: Delta v = 2 x FWHM of the emission line (the tclean mfs width)
assumptions: Flat LCDM, Omega_Lambda=0.7, Omega_m=0.3, H0=70 km/s/Mpc
R21 range seen in PG quasars 0.49-0.90 (0.99 from Carilli & Walter)

recipe.goal: Derive stellar masses from host photometry
recipe.method: GALIGHT 2D decomposition of HSC images gives host magnitudes (point sources removed) in five bands; CIGALE SED fit gives M*; merged hosts (J0847, J1416) get one M* for both
key_parameters: Delayed SFH, stellar population, dust attenuation, dust re-emission and nebular emission modules

recipe.goal: Compare gas fractions with the star-forming main sequence and compute SB/SFMS/QS probabilities
recipe.method: Sum M_molgas and M* per pair; evaluate Tacconi et al. 2020 scaling relation at each redshift (deltaMS=0, +/-1, logM*=10.7); combine measurement and systematic uncertainties using split normal PDFs; integrate probabilities in three regions
key_parameters: Systematics R21 = 0.62 +0.28/-0.13 and alpha_CO = 3.1 +1.2/-2.3 (converted to 1 sigma by halving the 95% bounds)
assumptions: PDF follows a split normal distribution

recipe.goal: Compare CO luminosities of dual and single quasars
recipe.method: Logrank (Mantel-Cox) test with upper limits against the Molina et al. 2023 PG sample

recipe.goal: Test a rotating-disk model for J1214+0102N
recipe.method: 3DBarolo ring-model fit to the cube with J1214S masked out; then dynamical mass from VROT and imfit major axis, and residual gas mass from Mdyn - M*
key_parameters: NRADII=7, RADSEP=0.187; XPOS, YPOS and PA fixed to imfit results; VROT, VDISP, INC, Z0 free
Initial guesses VROT=200, VDISP=40, INC=71, Z0=0
assumptions: Mdyn = Mgas + M*; factor 1.5 on the major axis; q0 = 0.2

evidence.quote: Among the ten quasars of the five pairs, eight have line detections exceeding $5\sigma$.

score_reason: Public archive data, CASA version, weighting, line windows and conversion constants are given and numeric tables are complete, but imaging parameters (cell, size, niter, masks), manual FWHM choices and SED-fit settings are missing, and there are small internal inconsistencies.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe (tclean mfs over 2xFWHM, imfit, R21=0.62, alpha_CO=3.1) is mostly specified and the main results (flux, L'CO, M_molgas) are numeric; stellar masses must be taken from the paper.
